bugs_found_pending_confirmation.title: Escape does not visually revert a move that displaced a neighbour
bugs_found_pending_confirmation.detail: Single pickup: offers (0,3) -> Enter -> ArrowUp -> offers (0,0), products pushed to (0,6) -> Escape. The announcement claims 'Move cancelled. Offers returned to its original position and size.' but the DOM stays at offers (0,0) / products (0,6). localStorage still holds the pre-pickup layout, so nothing is corrupted and a reload repairs the view - the user is simply told the cancel worked when the screen shows otherwise. THIS REFUTES #303's STATED RATIONALE for not snapshotting the layout ('real gridstack compaction is reversible ... verified live across five widgets'). A6 passes because its horizontal move+resize happens to revert cleanly.

bugs_found_pending_confirmation.title: A refused MOVE is announced (a refused RESIZE is correctly silent)
bugs_found_pending_confirmation.detail: products at (0,0), ArrowDown refused by gravity, gs-x/gs-y unchanged, yet 'Last products moved to column 1, row 1.' fired - twice. Same on offers. But ArrowLeft at x=0 was silent. The 'did anything change?' guard compares the CLAMPED REQUEST rather than the actual before/after. This is exactly the principle A3 requires, simply not applied to the move path. A screen-reader user pressing into a boundary hears a move that never happened.

bugs_found_pending_confirmation.title: A widget stays 'Picked up' after focus leaves it
bugs_found_pending_confirmation.detail: Pick up a widget, Tab out until activeElement is body; the widget keeps the --grabbed class and the 'Picked up...' aria-label. Escape from outside does nothing; recovery needs Shift+Tab back to that exact grid item. This is the logical consequence of #303's correct 'only act when the grid item owns the event' guard, with no focusout cancel to pair with it.

bugs_found_pending_confirmation.title: Focus drops to body when a dashboard range toggle is activated (WCAG 2.4.3)
bugs_found_pending_confirmation.detail: Keyboard: Enter on 7D sets 7D=true but activeElement becomes body. Mouse: same on 3M. The toggle group re-renders and the focused node is replaced with no focus restoration, so the next Tab restarts from the top of the document. Compounded by gridstack's item-level mousedown preventDefault suppressing focus (expected for drag support). Adjacent to this fix, not caused by it.

bugs_found_pending_confirmation.title: Spurious 'Widget positions updated' announcement on page load
bugs_found_pending_confirmation.detail: Fires on first load with no user action, when the persisted layout needs normalising on init (the save triggers the announcement). Later loads whose stored layout already matched were silent.

bugs_found_pending_confirmation.title: The public wrapper still ships the misleading grid aria-label, and a test pins it
bugs_found_pending_confirmation.detail: Live grid container: aria-label='Dashboard widgets. Drag widgets to rearrange.' - the pointer-only wording #272 explicitly claimed to have removed. Only the INNER component default was updated (GridstackDashboard.vue:193); DraggableDashboard.vue:40, the PUBLIC wrapper consumers render, is unchanged across v2.3.0/v2.4.0/v2.5.0. Both strings ship in the bundle and neither app chunk carries the old one, so this is a framework default, not a Vendor Portal override. It survived three PRs because DraggableDashboard.test.ts:67 PINS the stale string. So the first thing a screen-reader user hears on reaching the grid is still an instruction to do the one thing they cannot do.

bugs_found_pending_confirmation.title: Every dashboard announcement and label is hardcoded English - no i18n
bugs_found_pending_confirmation.detail: GridstackDashboard.vue imports no i18n at all (no useI18n, no $t, no t-call). All 8 announcement/label strings are bare literals. The framework ships locales/en.json AND locales/de.json (399 leaf keys), and it is not house style - vc-blade-navigation-new.vue does use $t for its aria-label. NOT covered by the VCST-5668 sweep, which is scoped to ui/ components plus SchedulerMonthView and SidebarHeader. Bears on AC2: changes are announced, but not in the user's language. Live localization was NOT verified (no language switch performed); the source read is decisive on its own.

not_bugs_verified_before_reporting: The localStorage/DOM mismatch after a keyboard drop (displaced neighbours written late) SELF-HEALS on reload and the visible layout is identical before and after - no user-visible defect.
The 7D/30D/90D and 3M/6M/12M toggles being disabled on first paint is the data-loading state; they enable once data arrives.
